rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese word for a ferry carrying passengers, vehicles, or goods, especially on a regular route.

example.english: We take the ferryboat across the harbour to get home.
example.traditional: 我哋搭渡輪過海返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 dou6 leon4 gwo3 hoi2 faan1 uk1 kei2
